Build a task tracker with projects, a board, a calendar and reports.

## Setup

~~~bash
npm install
npm run dev
~~~

- `npm run build`: build for production (type check included)

- `npm test`: run the Vitest suites

- `lib/dates.ts` — Date formatting and calendar helpers.
- `lib/storage.ts` — Local storage load and save.
